scenarios.prompt: Show me the details of this book — title, blurb, whatever is set on it.
scenarios.prompt_source: meta.synonyms ['book detail', 'show book']. book_id is required and is a CONTEXT id the runtime injects, so the request needs no id from the model.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF book_get is not ADVERTISED on 5/5 — the tool declares 'book detail'/'show book' and the request is that, so a miss is a surfacing defect rather than a model choice. CALLED is reported but is a weaker claim: a sibling read (book_read, book_list) answering the same words is a legitimate alternative, not a failure of this tool. CONTROL: book_id is context-injected, so a refusal naming a missing book_id would mean the runtime did not inject it — a different finding entirely.

ship_audit.gate: not owed — Tier R, no write.
ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a book with no blurb must read as empty, not as an error.

scenarios.prompt: What chapters does this book have? Give me the table of contents.
scenarios.prompt_source: meta.synonyms ['chapters', 'table of contents', 'toc'] — the request uses two of them verbatim.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF book_list_chapters is not ADVERTISED on 5/5. 🔴 THE KNOWN RIVAL, named in advance so the result is not read as a surprise: book_list ALSO declares 'list chapters' and 'table of contents', so both tools answer this request by their own declarations and either being called is legitimate. What would be a defect is NEITHER being advertised.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a book with no chapters must list empty, not error.

scenarios.prompt: Open chapter one and show me its text.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF book_get_chapter is not ADVERTISED on 5/5. It requires chapter_id as well as book_id — both context ids the runtime injects when the turn carries editor context. 🔴 IF THE TURN CARRIES NO CHAPTER CONTEXT the model must first find the chapter, so a run that calls book_list_chapters then this tool is the CORRECT sequence and not a miss. A refusal naming a missing chapter_id is the finding to look for.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a chapter with no draft must read as empty.

scenarios.prompt: Show me the motif detail — its roles and its beats.
scenarios.prompt_source: meta.synonyms ['motif detail', 'motif roles', 'motif beats'] — three of them, verbatim.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF composition_motif_get is not ADVERTISED on 5/5. 🔴 IT REQUIRES motif_id, which is NOT a context id and has ONE observed supplier — so a run that calls a motif LIST first and then this tool is the correct sequence, and a run that fabricates a motif_id is the fabricated-id class, not a surfacing defect. Both outcomes are informative; report which.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — an unknown motif_id must refuse, not return an empty motif.
